= camel kubernetes

Manage Camel applications running on Kubernetes

NOTE: This command is provided by the `kubernetes` plugin. Install it with `camel plugin add kubernetes`.


== Usage

[source,bash]
----
camel kubernetes [options]
----


== Subcommands

[cols="2,5",options="header"]
|===
| Subcommand | Description
| xref:jbang-commands/camel-jbang-kubernetes-delete.adoc[delete] | Delete Camel application from Kubernetes. This operation will delete all resources associated to this app, such as: Deployment, Routes, Services, etc. filtering by label app.kubernetes.io/name=<name>.
| xref:jbang-commands/camel-jbang-kubernetes-export.adoc[export] | Export as Maven project that contains a Kubernetes deployment manifest
| xref:jbang-commands/camel-jbang-kubernetes-logs.adoc[logs] | Print the logs of a Kubernetes pod
| xref:jbang-commands/camel-jbang-kubernetes-run.adoc[run] | Run Camel application on Kubernetes
|===
